privacyBody: Shiftna stores your name, phone, grade, city, and the documents you upload (Syndicate card, practice license, specialty certificate and a selfie) so we can confirm you are a licensed anesthesia doctor.
Documents are kept in a private storage area. Only you and the Shiftna review team can open them, through links that expire after a few minutes. Other doctors never see your documents.
Other approved doctors can see your name, grade, city, reliability numbers and ratings. Your phone number is shared with the doctor you are booked with.
Chat messages are visible only to the two doctors in a booking, and to admins reviewing a reported problem.
We do not store any patient information. Never write patient names or identifying details in chats, notes or ratings.
We collect anonymous usage counts (for example, how many shifts are posted) to improve the service. These never include names, phone numbers, notes or chat text.
Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law (Law 151 of 2020) applies. To see, correct or delete your data, contact the Shiftna team.
termsBody: Shiftna connects licensed anesthesia doctors who need cover with doctors who can provide it. Shiftna is not a party to any agreement between doctors or hospitals.
You must be a licensed doctor and upload genuine, current documents. Accounts with false documents are removed.
You are responsible for following your hospital's rules and Egyptian Medical Syndicate rules, and for only accepting work you are qualified for.
Payment is agreed and made outside the app during the pilot. Mark payments honestly.
Cancelling less than 24 hours before a shift is recorded on your profile. Repeated no-shows or late cancellations may lead to suspension.
Ratings must be honest and respectful. Admins may remove abusive comments.
Report any problem from the booking screen. The Shiftna team reviews every report.
